Nina: Routing: create SFDC campaign "CH-Marketplace-Dec2026". Route marketplace leads to partner-sdr for 48h, then to AE. Tag high-intent leads for immediate follow-up.

Avery: I'll put a draft blog outline in Drive and add headline variants.

Yuki: Send me sample prompt lengths and expected concurrency so I can pick batching.

Nina: Action items: Rob = webinar ops, Yuki = benchmark, Avery = blog, Sales/RevOps = SFDC campaign. Target: assets ready by Dec 1. :white_check_mark:
